'''xcshort SYCFA V 2''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[xcshort]]
* '''Published:''' 14 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]

* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 SYCFA xcshort DS 2003 SYCFAV2.txt |Download]]
